correctness.rationale: Direct computation of the p-Ret circle increments from its coordinate definition. Uniform-sphere projection gives exact beta density and Bessel multipliers. For r>=2, characteristic-function strictness and Riemann-Lebesgue force a sharp strict L2 spectral gap; two-step L2 density yields geometric TV mixing. For r=1, arithmetic approximation yields norm one; rational cases have Poisson kernel and irrational cases have explicit continuous forcing with no L2 solution. The 377 finite checks independently support, but cannot replace, these analytic arguments.
